home.intro: I've loved computers for as long as I can remember, and over the years it became my job. Away from the screen, you'll find me on my bike or surrounded by cats :)

story.p1: My name is Héctor Ríos, I'm 20 years old and I'm from Medellín. I've loved computers for as long as I can remember, and over the years that curiosity became the path I want to follow.
story.p2: I started in web development, learning to build interfaces, connect systems and take an idea to something functional that people could use. As I progressed, I discovered the world of data and was fascinated by it: understanding what is behind information, how it is organized and what can be drawn from it.
story.p3: Today I'm on the advanced Data Analysis track at Riwi, where I also strengthen my soft skills, my emotional management and my English. Outside of class I keep learning on my own: I'm quite self-taught, so if something sparks my curiosity, I don't rest until I understand how it works.
